Doesnt quite work for dedicated. Warps wont get saved, and only get synched upon creation. 
If Person A Creates Warp, Person B will see it. But if either get a disconnct, relog oder plays the next Day warp list is empty again. Even if A stays, B disconnects and then rejoins he wont see the warps unless they get recreated. 
Tested with only this Mod and its dependency .
